title: Siemens Mobility Ltd v High Speed Two (HS2) Ltd
description: High Speed Two (HS2) Ltd's procurement of a manufacture and supply agreement for at least 54 rolling stock units and an associated train maintenance and services agreement was challenged by Siemens Mobility Ltd, who alleged manifest error in scores, breach of public law principles, abnormally low bid, and undisclosed conflicts of interest. The judge dismissed all 17 claims, finding no breaches of equal treatment, non-discrimination or transparency.
